documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Aditya Infotech reported its strongest half-year performance with consolidated revenue of INR 3,148 crores and EBITDA of INR 515 crores for H1 FY2027. The company completed a INR 1,500 crores QIP in September and is now debt-free after repaying all borrowings in October. Management raised its full-year FY2027 revenue guidance to INR 6,500 crores-INR 6,800 crores, maintained EBITDA margin guidance at 14%-15%, and raised PAT margin guidance to 9%-10%. Additionally, the company announced strategic investments in localization, manufacturing capacity expansion, and a 30% stake acquisition in BLUE KGraph AI Solutions. Aditya Infotech Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 consolidated financial results, highlighting a significant surge in revenue, operating profit, and net cash following a recent QIP and debt repayment.

guidance.claim: The company expects its FY2027 market share to be in the range of 43% to 45%.
guidance.quote: On our revised guidance, our FY2027 share is expected to be in the range of 43% to 45%.

guidance.claim: The company raised its FY2027 revenue guidance to INR 6,500 crores to INR 6,800 crores.
guidance.quote: Revenue, we are raising it to INR 6,500 crores, INR 6,800 crores, up from INR 6,000 crores, INR 6,500 crores, which is a growth of 54% to 61% over the year.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY27 revenue guidance to ₹6,500–6,800 Cr, representing a 54–61% growth rate.
Management maintained its EBITDA margin guidance for FY27 at 14–15%.
PAT margin guidance for FY27 was raised to 9–10%.
Management stated guidance for the year is 14% to 15% EBITDA.
guidance.quote: So Naushad, I think we have given our guidance for the year, which is 14% to 15% EBITDA.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that critical semiconductor components like SOC, DDR, and flash prices have risen sharply across the electronics industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Critical semiconductor components like SOC, DDR, and flash prices have risen sharply across the electronics industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the industry's move to higher data security standards and trusted supply chains played to the company's strengths.
demand_outlook.quote: The industry's move to higher data security standards as well as trusted supply chains played to our strengths.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian video-surveillance market size is estimated at ₹15,000 Cr in FY27 and projected to reach ₹26,000 Cr by FY30 at a ~20% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: Market size: company estimates · Aditya Infotech Limited · Q2 & H1 FY27 Results 9

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that price hikes have varied between 10% to 20% so far.
demand_outlook.quote: It has varied from between 10% to 20% so far.

demand_outlook.claim: Management has not seen any major consumption effect from price adjustments.
demand_outlook.quote: So far we have not seen any consumption effect in a major way and we hope that we are able to mitigate the inflationary pressures in the coming future.

capex_expansion.claim: The fully integrated lens plant is planned in Greater Noida with a capacity of 2 million lenses per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Our fully integrated lens plant is planned in Greater Noida with a capacity of 2 million lenses per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The housing and enclosures plant in Kadapa begins trials this quarter, with commercial production starting next quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: The housing and enclosures plant in Kadapa begins trials this quarter, with commercial production coming in place from the coming quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: The cable plant will go live in Q4 of this financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The cable plant will also go live in Q4 of this financial year, which is next quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved investing INR 45.4 crores for a 30% stake on a fully diluted basis in BLUE KGraph AI Solutions.
capex_expansion.quote: Our board approved, and we signed agreements to invest INR 45.4 crores for a 30% stake on a fully diluted basis in BLUE KGraph AI Solutions.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion across Kadapa phase 3 and Greater Noida will entail a total capex of about INR 650 crores to double capacities by late FY2029 to early FY2030.
capex_expansion.quote: This will entail a total of about INR 650 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The housing and enclosure expansion is expected to become operational by Q3 of this financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Our housing and enclosure expansion is progressing as planned and is expected to become operational by Q3 of this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Land acquisition for the Kadapa greenfield expansion is in final stages.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also advancing on our Kadapa greenfield expansion and the land acquisition for same is in final stages.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed facility in Rajasthan will cover approximately 1 lakh square feet and start commercial production by the end of the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The proposed facility in Rajasthan will cover approximately 1 lakh square feet and is expected to start commercial production by end of this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin in Q2 was 30%, flat year-on-year, and slightly below Q1 as the company began absorbing part of the input cost increase in SOC and memory.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, gross margin was 30%, flat year-on-year, and slightly below Q1, 30.8%, as we began absorbing part of the input cost increase in SOC and memory.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 gross margin stood at 30.0% and EBITDA margin at 17.6%.
Q1 FY2027 gross margin stood at 30.8%, up 810 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Our gross margin stood at 30.8%, up 810 basis points year-on-year, with CP PLUS contribution rising to 87% of our revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 EBITDA stood at INR 208 crores, up 20% year-on-year, with margins improving by 604 basis points to 14.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR208 crores, up 20% year-on-year, with margins improving by 604 basis points to 14.8%, supported by a favorable product and brand mix, as well as better operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Adjusted PAT stood at INR 142.2 crores, up 332.5% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Adjusted PAT stood at INR142.2 crores, up 332.5% year-on-year, attributed to lowering of finance costs by 59% year-on-year and better cost efficiencies.

orders_capacity.claim: In the 12 months to September 2026, the company's share of the total video surveillance market was about 42%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the 12 months to September 2026, our share of the total market, including the unorganized segment, was about 42%, which at the time of our IPO was 30%.

orders_capacity.claim: The Kadapa facility currently supports a capacity of approximately 2.5 million units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The Kadapa facility currently supports a capacity of approximately 2.5 million units per month, providing a strong foundation for future growth.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has a total of 42 FA lines, 4 MI and 12 SMT lines by the end of August.
orders_capacity.quote: This month we are adding three more FA lines and one MI line and with this addition, we have a total of 42 FA lines, 4 MI and 12 SMT lines by the end of August.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is between 85% to 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, Shubham, our current capacity is at about 2.5 million units per month and currently our capacity utilization should be at between 85% to 90%.

capital_allocation.claim: In September, the company completed its qualified institutions placement and raised INR 1,500 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In September, we completed our qualified institutions placement and raised INR 1,500 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: In October, the company repaid all its borrowings and is now debt-free.
capital_allocation.quote: In October, we repaid all our borrowings, and now the company is debt free.

capital_allocation.claim: On 30th September, cash and cash equivalents were INR 1,434 crores against borrowings of INR 363 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On 30th September, cash and cash equivalents were INR 1,434 crores against borrowing of INR 363 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivable days came down to 87 in Q2 from 93 in Q1 and 105 a year ago.
capital_allocation.quote: Receivable days came down to 87 in Q2 from 93 in Q1 and 105 a year ago.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt to equity reduced sharply to just the 0.07 level.
capital_allocation.quote: At the same time, our balance sheet remains robust, with debt to equity reducing sharply to just 0.07 level.

risks_headwinds.claim: Reported PAT for quarter two included a one-time exceptional item of INR 34.4 crores from a fire incident at the Kadapa plant due to a short circuit in September.
risks_headwinds.quote: Reported PAT for quarter two was INR 185.5 crores after a one-time exceptional item of INR 34.4 crores from a fire incident that happened in our Kadapa plant due to short circuit in September.

risks_headwinds.claim: The loss from the fire incident at the Kadapa plant is fully covered by insurance, and the claim has already been lodged.
risks_headwinds.quote: The loss is fully covered by insurance, and the claim has already been lodged.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that cost hikes in DDR and SOC have been phenomenal across all product categories.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, we are trying to not pass the whole by price hike at one go in the market because the cost hike in DDR and SOC has been phenomenal across all product categories and not only CCTV.

management_commitments.claim: The rollout of the new range of CP PLUS PRO series targeting the premium enterprise segment is planned in Q4 of FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: The new range of CP PLUS PRO series targets the premium enterprise segment, and its rollout is planned in the Q4 of FY2027.

management_commitments.claim: The cable plant will go live in Q4 of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: The cable plant will also go live in Q4 of this financial year, which is next quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to roll out premium PTZ, thermal, and 4K solutions for the enterprise segment in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: PTZ, thermal and 4K for the ~10% high-margin enterprise segment; rollout Q4 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Several new professional offerings and home IoT products are targeted to launch by the fourth quarter of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Several of these offerings are currently under final stage of development and targeted to launch by the Q4 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production at the Rajasthan cable manufacturing facility is expected to start by the end of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: The proposed facility in Rajasthan will cover approximately 1 lakh square feet and is expected to start commercial production by end of this financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
